verdict.rationale: CSC's entity management product documents in-product AI that produces 'instant summaries of key content' and automates entity and folder routing for documents. That is a real AI-generated insight capability, but it covers only document summarization and routing, not insights or suggestions drawn from the user's broader entity data. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights and recommendations across entity and compliance data, any documented suggestion or recommendation feature, depth of documentation for the AI summaries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Leverage AI to simplify document management, including bulk document imports, automated entity and folder routing, and instant summaries of key content
